label: Agent: Get Conversation
description: Read an agent conversation: waits for the call to finish (default), then emits the transcript as a JSON file, the summary, whether the call succeeded, the data and criteria results, how long it lasted and what it cost, and optionally the whole conversation, its trace and the recording.

inputs.name: account
inputs.description: Your own ElevenLabs account (conversations live in it; the shared credential cannot serve this).

inputs.name: conversationId
inputs.description: The conversation to read (from Agent: Place Call).

inputs.name: waitUntilDone
inputs.label: Wait for the call to finish
inputs.description: Off = answer the current state immediately.

inputs.name: includeAudio
inputs.label: Download the recording
inputs.description: Also fetch the call audio and emit it on the audio port.

outputs.name: status
outputs.description: done, failed, or the in-flight state when not waiting.

outputs.name: transcript
outputs.description: A JSON file holding the transcript: `turns`, each turn's `role` (`agent` or `user`) and `message`; and `text`, the whole transcript as one line per turn, starting with its role (`agent: Hello!`). It is a file because a long call's transcript is more than a wire can carry.

outputs.name: summaryTitle
outputs.description: A short title for the call, from the analysis.

outputs.name: successful
outputs.description: The analysis's call outcome (success / failure / unknown).

outputs.name: successScore
outputs.description: The analysis's overall success score for the call, when it gives one.

outputs.name: dataCollection
outputs.description: Each data collection item's id and the value ElevenLabs found for it in the conversation, once the analysis is done: the items Agent: Create's `dataCollection` set up.

outputs.name: evaluation
outputs.description: Each success criterion's id and its result (`success`, `failure` or `unknown`), once the analysis is done: the criteria Agent: Create's `evaluationCriteria` set up.

outputs.name: durationSecs
outputs.description: How long the call lasted, in seconds.

outputs.name: terminationReason
outputs.description: Why the call ended, in ElevenLabs's words.

outputs.name: costUsd
outputs.description: What the conversation cost in US dollars, as ElevenLabs reports it: the model's price plus ElevenLabs's own.

outputs.name: conversation
outputs.description: A JSON file holding the whole conversation object, exactly as ElevenLabs answers it. Stored only when something reads this port.

outputs.name: otlpTrace
outputs.description: A JSON file holding the conversation as an OpenTelemetry (OTLP) trace, with the structure of ElevenLabs's post-call webhook. ElevenLabs is only asked for it when something reads this port.

outputs.name: audio
outputs.description: The call recording (when Download the recording is on).
